title: VCS Core TypeScript Mirror
description: Build the missing `vcs/core` TypeScript bundle: a hand-written wire-compatible mirror of `vcs/rs` (Rust/WASM VCS engine), since wasm-bindgen exports nothing usable directly. Mirror types (Author, Edit, Change, Checkpoint, Alternative), a generic DocumentVcsStore (dispatch: apply/undo/redo/commit checkpoint/create+switch alternative), ingestRemote, mergeRemoteSnapshot, materializeDocumentProjection, and buildHistoryColumns for the future vcs/react HistoryTable. Operations are generic (forwards/backwards fn pairs) with a toy counter op used only in fixtures/tests. Wrap any hashing behind an injectable Hasher interface. Mirror framework/product/os/core/js's directory/nx/test conventions exactly. Register vcs/core in root package.json workspaces. If sibling ticket 0C (StudioVcsHost/StudioMember in vcs/rs/lib.rs) has landed, also mirror the studio layer; otherwise defer and note it.
summary:
Created the new `vcs/core` bundle: a hand-written, wire-compatible TypeScript mirror of `vcs/rs`'s `DocumentVcsStore` (wasm-bindgen exports nothing usable, so this is a from-scratch camelCase-identical mirror of `vcs/rs/lib.rs`, cross-checked against `framework/core/rs` for `HybridLogicalTimestamp`/`UndoPolicy`/`OpEnvelope`/`OpDag`).

Package/project name: `@semio-tech/vcs-core` (directory `vcs/core`, matching `vcs/rs`'s `@semio-tech/vcs-rs` naming). Nx targets: `test` (`bun nx run @semio-tech/vcs-core:test`, runs in-source vitest via `js/vitest.config.ts`) and `typecheck` (`bun nx run @semio-tech/vcs-core:typecheck`, `tsc --noEmit -p js/tsconfig.json`). Both verified green (34 tests passing, 0 typecheck errors). Directory/nx conventions mirror `cad/core` (headless library with `js/tsconfig.json extends ../../../tsconfig.json`) since `framework/product/os/core` lacked a typecheck target; the `typecheck` target itself mirrors `ui/js/react`'s `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` pattern.

Public API surface (all in `vcs/core/js/index.ts` unless noted):
- Types: `Author`, `OperationMeta`, `Edit<Op>`, `Change`, `Checkpoint`, `Alternative`, `DocumentVcs<P,Op>`, `DocumentVcsEnvelope<P,Op>`, `DocumentVcsCommand<Op>`, `HybridLogicalTimestamp`, `UndoPolicy`, `OpEnvelope`, `HistoryColumn`.
- `VcsError` (class, `.kind` discriminant matching every `vcs::VcsError` variant message).
- `OperationHandlers<P, Op>` — the per-document-schema operation contract (`forwards`/`backwards` functions + optional meta hooks); ops are plain JSON-serializable values, registered via a handlers object passed to the store (not methods on the op itself, so edits round-trip through JSON exactly like the Rust wire format).
- `createDocumentVcsEnvelope`, `materializeDocumentProjection`, `buildHistoryColumns` (standalone functions).
- `DocumentVcsStore<P, Op>` class — `dispatch` (apply/undo/redo/undoWithPolicy/commitCheckpoint/createAlternative/switchAlternative/checkoutCheckpoint/amendLast), `projection`, `ingestRemote` (minimal causal buffer, ordered-by-deps replay — simplified vs. Rust's `OpDag` per the ticket's stated scope), `mergeRemoteSnapshot`, `historyColumns`, accessors (`getEnvelope`, `appliedEditIds`, `redoEditIds`, `generation`, `currentCheckpointId`/`setCurrentCheckpointId`, `localActorId`/`setLocalActorId`, `editOperations`, `setState`). No `Backbone`/`pump`/`flushOutbound` mirror — that IO-owning plumbing lives in `framework/sync`'s actor layer and has no TS mirror yet (out of this ticket's scope).
- `Hasher` interface + `createDefaultHasher()` in `vcs/core/js/hasher.ts` — blake3 hex digest via `@noble/hashes/blake3`, imported only in that one file; `index.ts` depends solely on the `Hasher` interface, computing a `payloadHash` per operation exactly like Rust's `semio_framework_hash::hash_bytes`.

Ticket 0C (`STUDIO-VCS-LAYER-AND-RECONCILE-HOOK`) landed in `vcs/rs/lib.rs` partway through this ticket, so per the brief's step 5 the studio layer is now mirrored too (not deferred): `StudioMember` interface (which `DocumentVcsStore` implements directly — TS needs no `as_any_mut` downcast escape hatch since callers already hold typed store references), `StudioMemberPin`, `StudioCheckpoint`, `StudioAlternative`, `StudioHistoryProjection`, `StudioHistoryOp`, `studioHistoryOpHandlers`, and `StudioVcsHost` (`commitStudioCheckpoint` dirty-member fan-out, `checkoutStudioCheckpoint`/`switchStudioAlternative` fan-out, `undo`/`redo` derived by max `HybridLogicalTimestamp` across members). Rust's newer `reconcile`/`conflicts`/`projection_with_conflicts` additions (visible in `vcs/rs/lib.rs`'s test module, apparently from further concurrent work beyond ticket 0C) were intentionally NOT mirrored — out of this ticket's stated scope.

Test coverage (34 in-source vitest tests across `index.ts`/`hasher.ts`, using a toy `CounterOp`/`TimestampedOp` per the ticket's guidance — no real `OsOp` port): apply/undo/redo/commit/checkout/foreign-edit-rejection/amendLast-coalescing/mergeRemoteSnapshot/ingestRemote/buildHistoryColumns, a hand-authored JSON fixture (`vcs/core/js/fixtures/checkpoint-undo-redo-branch.json`) replaying a checkpoint→undo→redo→createAlternative(discards uncommitted)→apply→commit sequence with asserted `projection.n` after each command, and the four `StudioVcsHost` scenarios mirroring `vcs/rs`'s own studio tests (commit pins dirty members, checkout fans out, switch-alternative fans out, undo/redo target the member with the highest HLT). No shared fixture directory in `framework/sync/fixtures` was reused — those are actor-level (hub frame/external-folder) fixtures, a different layer than `DocumentVcsStore.dispatch`; a hand-authored fixture local to `vcs/core` was the right fit per the ticket's own fallback guidance.

Registered `"vcs/core"` in the root `package.json` workspaces array, next to `"vcs/rs"`.

IMPORTANT CAVEAT: `bun install` currently fails repo-wide with `error: Workspace not found "mathematical/graph/port/directed/dag"` — that directory is present in `bun.lock` and the workspaces array but missing on disk (only a `normal` subdirectory exists there), unrelated to this ticket and consistent with another session's in-progress rename/refactor of that package. I could not get a clean `bun install` to complete, so `bun.lock` was NOT updated with the new `@noble/hashes` dependency or the `vcs/core` workspace entry. To unblock local verification I manually extracted the official `@noble/hashes@1.8.0` npm tarball into `node_modules/@noble/hashes` (not committed — it's inside `node_modules`, gitignored) and ran `test`/`typecheck` directly against that; both nx targets pass cleanly (34/34 tests, 0 typecheck errors) once dependencies resolve. Whoever next runs `bun install` after the `mathematical/graph/port/directed/dag` workspace is fixed should get a clean, complete lockfile update automatically — no further action needed on the `vcs/core` side.

Files created: vcs/core/package.json, vcs/core/project.json, vcs/core/script.ts, vcs/core/js/index.ts, vcs/core/js/hasher.ts, vcs/core/js/tsconfig.json, vcs/core/js/vitest.config.ts, vcs/core/js/fixtures/checkpoint-undo-redo-branch.json.
Files modified: package.json (added "vcs/core" to workspaces).
